name: 06108 · East Hartford, CT
findings: ZIP 06108 (East Hartford) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06108 (East Hartford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06108 (East Hartford) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
